TABLE.NAME: local_ustar_skill_evidence
TABLE.COMMENT: Evidence definitions linking USTAR skills to Moodle learning, assessment and later competency sources

FIELD.NAME: skillid
FIELD.COMMENT: USTAR skill id from the versioned structure

FIELD.NAME: positionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional USTAR position scope; null means shared evidence

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional Moodle course_modules id for activity-level evidence

FIELD.NAME: evidencetype
FIELD.COMMENT: learning | assessment | practice | manager_review | checklist | certification

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative contribution of this evidence definition

FIELD.NAME: required
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this evidence is required for the skill readiness model

FIELD.NAME: validdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Validity period in days; 0 means no expiry
